Club: Light Music.description:
🎸 You are a member of the U.A. Light Music club.

🗓️ It meets after classes on Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday, in the Music Room.
🤝 Kyoka Jiro runs it; Present Mic is the advisor.
📈 Grants: Performance +5. Practice counts as training.

Say "I quit the club" to leave it.
Club: Light Music.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is a member of the U.A. Light Music club, run by Kyoka Jiro with Present Mic as advisor; it meets after classes on Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday in the Music Room. The lead and members know they are a member (never ask them to sign up again). Going to practice is the player's choice each time; a missed practice is fine, a habit of missing gets one honest word from the lead. Club time is real time: an afternoon at the club is an afternoon not spent elsewhere.
